title: Microelectrode recordings (MER) from deep brain stimulation surgery in Parkinson's disease (STN targeting, 14 patients)
description: Intraoperative microelectrode recordings (MER) from 14 patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing stereotactic deep brain stimulation (DBS) surgery targeting the subthalamic nucleus. Recordings were acquired at up to three channels and at multiple depths along left and right trajectories. Each depth is labeled as inside (STN-IN) or outside (STN-OUT) the nucleus. The data are unfiltered and were re-packaged from a Zenodo release into iEEG-BIDS without signal processing.
methods_description: MER were recorded during DBS surgery at La Fe Hospital (Valencia, Spain), with up to three channels per depth and no filtering applied to the release data. Sampling rate was about 12 kHz. The original MATLAB int16 arrays were converted losslessly to BrainVision float32 with BIDS sidecars. Channels of unequal length were NaN-padded.
